title_zh: 让科幻动画的开场交代清楚来访者

scenario.label_zh: 根据反馈调整影片开头
scenario.goal_zh: 剪辑者根据试映反馈调整短片开头。

context_zh: 导演卓娅看完剪辑师本的科幻动画新版本后，讨论如何让观众理解开场的来访角色。
author: author-phase06-c

sentences.speaker: Director Zoya
sentences.text: The animation is beautiful, but I thought the visitor was a ghost until the spaceship appeared.

sentences.speaker: Editor Ben
sentences.text: I wanted the alien to seem mysterious. Should I show the ship sooner?

sentences.speaker: Director Zoya
sentences.text: Yes. The audience needs to know this is a living being from another planet, not someone returning from the dead.

sentences.speaker: Editor Ben
sentences.text: Would a brief view of the ship before the door opens be enough?

sentences.speaker: Director Zoya
sentences.text: I think so. The door opening onto a whole forest is an astonishing image; keep that reveal.

sentences.speaker: Editor Ben
sentences.text: And the audio track? At the moment there is a whisper before we see anything.

sentences.speaker: Director Zoya
sentences.text: Replace the whisper with the engine slowing down. Save the amusing sneeze for when the visitor steps into the flowers.

sentences.speaker: Editor Ben
sentences.text: That gives the sneeze a reason. I will add the ship first, change the sound, and keep the forest reveal.

sentences.speaker: Director Zoya
sentences.text: Good. Let us watch the revised opening together before you work on the next scene.
